name: Code or binary change
definition: a software deployment, rollout or release.

name: Configuration change
definition: a change to configuration data, a feature flag, a policy or a rule, by a person or a pipeline.

name: Planned operation
definition: maintenance, migration, capacity addition or removal, decommissioning, scaling work done on purpose.

name: Automation acting wrongly
definition: an automated system (scaler, remediation, DNS or routing automation) took an action nobody intended.

name: Demand surge
definition: organic traffic growth, a spike, or a retry storm that starts the incident.

name: Latent defect activated
definition: a bug present for some time that fires on a date, time, data size, limit or rare condition.

name: Hardware failure
definition: server, disk, switch, router or other device failure.

name: Facility event
definition: power loss, cooling or thermal event, fire, flood, weather.

name: External network event
definition: fiber cut, route leak or outage at a carrier or internet exchange outside the provider.

name: Upstream dependency failure outside the provider
definition: a third party the provider relies on.

name: Expiry or exhaustion
definition: a certificate, credential or key expired, or a fixed resource ran out (address space, disk, quota) without a demand surge.

name: Attack
definition: a denial-of-service attack or other malicious action.

name: Operator error
definition: a person ran the wrong command, on the wrong target, or with wrong input, outside a planned change.
